overviewParagraphs: Blue Canyon Country Club is one of the defining golf experiences in Phuket — a course whose canyon layouts, emerald water features, and dramatic finishing holes have made it a must-play destination for visiting golfers for three decades. Multiple Johnnie Walker Classic championships were held here, cementing its reputation as a genuine international stage.

The Canyon Course is the headline offering: a routing through rubber plantation and over water-filled canyons that were created when the land was previously mined. The resulting visual drama is extraordinary, and the strategic demand is equally serious — water threatens approach shots on numerous occasions in the back nine, and the canyon-framed par threes are among the most photographed holes in Asia.

AGS consistently recommends Blue Canyon as the mandatory first round on any Phuket golf trip, setting the tone for the island's premium golf offering and establishing an aesthetic benchmark that all subsequent rounds will be measured against.

curatorBriefHtml: Blue Canyon Country Club (Canyon Course) — opened in 1991 by Yoshikazu Kato just 10 minutes from Phuket International Airport — is the most storied championship course in Southern Thailand. Famous for hosting three Johnnie Walker Classics (including Tiger Woods’s legendary 1998 drive onto the par-4 13th green across the canyon), the 7,165-yard Par 72 layout threads through abandoned tin-mine canyons, rubber plantations, and jungle ravines.

Having played the Canyon Course personally, its dramatic back nine — headlined by the cliff-carry par-4 13th and the breathtaking island-style par-3 14th — still delivers spine-tingling championship theater. Its companion 18-hole Lakes Course offers wider fairways and abundant water hazards for groups planning a 36-hole day. Compare Phuket’s top two icons in Red Mountain vs. Blue Canyon.
Sitting only 10 minutes from Phuket Airport (HKT) and 25 minutes from Banyan Tree Phuket, Blue Canyon is the ultimate arrival-day or headline round on any Southern Thailand golf escape.

scorecard.verdict: Phuket's historic championship proving ground. Host to the Johnnie Walker Classic, the Canyon Course features Tiger Woods' famous drive across the canyon on hole 13 and tests mental fortitude across deep chasms.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the Canyon Course and Lakes Course at Blue Canyon?
faqs.a: The Canyon Course (opened 1991) is the tight, dramatic, tree-and-canyon-lined Johnnie Walker Classic championship track. The Lakes Course (opened 1999) features wider fairways, larger greens, and water hazards on 17 of 18 holes.

faqs.q: How close is Blue Canyon Country Club to Phuket International Airport?
faqs.a: Just 8 to 12 minutes from Phuket International Airport (HKT), making it effortless to play on arrival day or right before a late-afternoon departure.

faqs.q: Which is better in Phuket: Blue Canyon Canyon Course or Red Mountain?
faqs.a: Red Mountain delivers wilder vertical tin-mine elevation changes and modern visual drama, while Blue Canyon Canyon Course offers classic championship tournament history and tight strategic shotmaking. Every serious Phuket itinerary plays both.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play Blue Canyon?
faqs.a: November through April is Phuket’s dry Andaman season with sunny skies and firmer canyon turf.
